start_channel_service: start the global ChannelService singleton from the application config and return it
create_ChannelService: create a ChannelService instance with channels config to manage IM channel lifecycles
build_channel_service_from_app_config: build a ChannelService from the DeerFlow app config using the from_app_config class method
test_ChannelService_get_status: test the ChannelService get_status method to check enabled and running state of all channels
refactor_ChannelService_restart_channel: refactor the ChannelService restart_channel method to restart a specific IM channel by name
